newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila seeks financial advisers for privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Manila seeks financial advisers for privatisation.

text.p: The state-owned Bases Conversion Development Authority (Basecon) said on Tuesday it had invited about 40 foreign and local financial firms to help undertake its privatisation and development plans.

Basecon chairman Victorino Basco said it would choose five financial advisers to assist the agency and its seven units in financial planning, financial structuring, project evaluation and all other financed related tasks.
Basecon is currently involved in developing a freeport zone, an airport, a technology park, a railway and a financial district in Manila.
The financing of the projects can be mandated to either one of the five companies.
Among those which have been invited are ING Barings, Hong Kong Shanghai Banking Corp, Salomon Brothers and Merill Lynch.
The deadline for submission of credentials has been set on May 5, while the announcement of the five companies will be on May 12.
Basecon would choose the five advisers based on their global network, financial capability and track record, Basco added.
